mapper.select:
select t1.PRICE_LIST,t1.DESCRIPTION,t1.ENABLED_FLAG from hls_price_list t1
1=1 and t1.enabled_flag='Y'
and t1.price_list in ('EXTENSION_COMPOUND','EXTENSION_EQUAL_PRINCIPAL','EXTENSION_EQUAL_PRINCIPAL_COMPOUND','INTEREST_PAYMENT_POSTPONEMENT','YH_EQUAL_PRINCIPAL','YX_EQUAL_RENTAL','Yh_EQUAL_PRINCIPAL_FREE','Yh_EQUAL_RENTAL_FREE')
and t1.price_list like concat(concat('%',#{priceList,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
and t1.description like concat(concat('%',#{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
and t1.enabled_flag = #{enabledFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
order by t1.price_list

select t1.price_list, t1.description, t1.enabled_flag, t1.payment_type, ( select scvb.meaning from sys_code_b scb,sys_code_value_b scvb where scb.code = 'HLS.PRICE_LIST_PAYMENT_TYPE' and scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.value = t1.payment_type ) as payment_type_n, t1.adjust_rate_price, t1.adjust_rate_description
from hls_price_list t1
t1.price_list like concat(concat('%',#{priceList,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
and t1.description like concat(concat('%',#{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
and t1.enabled_flag = #{enabledFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
order by t1.price_list
